_ANSWERED_2026_09_05.STATUS: DONE -- answered WITHOUT a Freebase download
_ANSWERED_2026_09_05.method: The released RoG graph is itself a LABELLED OBSERVATION of Freebase name coverage: RoG rendered an endpoint as a name where Freebase had type.object.name and left the bare MID where it did not. Per Freebase TYPE (relation id minus its last component, e.g. people.marriage.spouse -> people.marriage) we therefore MEASURE the named rate. Two independent query-independent signals per node: pass 1 = the types the node asserts as a head; pass 2 = the RANGE of the relations pointing at it. No question text, answers, gold paths, topic annotations or neighbour names were used.

NAME_RESOLVABLE_UNCERTAINTY_BAND._reading: the population a Freebase metadata pass would actually rescue is 0.75%-2.41% of union entities. Reported as a band rather than collapsed to a point.

EVIDENCE_THE_SPLIT_IS_REAL_NOT_A_THRESHO.bimodality: over 3,119 distinct types: 556 types have named-rate < 0.01, 2,531 have > 0.9, only ~20 lie in between. The relation-range histogram has the same shape (1,460 relations < 0.01, 5,514 > 0.9).

threshold_sensitivity._reading: a 20x change in tau moves the answer by 0.45%. tau=0.02 used throughout.

EVIDENCE_THE_SPLIT_IS_REAL_NOT_A_THRESHO.control_false_positive_rate: of 533,758 endpoints RoG DID name (so they demonstrably have type.object.name) and which have outgoing edges, only 238 (0.045%) are false-positively called mediator-like.
EVIDENCE_THE_SPLIT_IS_REAL_NOT_A_THRESHO.cross_validation: pass 2 re-labels, from incoming relations ONLY, the 1,014,462 bare MIDs pass 1 could label from outgoing types only. 1,011,820 carry an in-relation signal; agreement 95.75%.
EVIDENCE_THE_SPLIT_IS_REAL_NOT_A_THRESHO.domain_validation: the types called mediators are the textbook Freebase CVTs: film.performance (198,122 nodes, rate 0.0002), common.webpage (121,320), award.award_nomination (63,096), film.film_crew_gig (56,716), education.education (34,469), award.award_honor (34,368), tv.tv_guest_role (28,798), measurement_unit.dated_integer (26,953, exactly 0), sports.sports_team_roster (19,581), music.track_contribution (18,573). The types called ordinary are people.person (0.99997), film.film (0.9982), location.location (0.9602), book.written_work (0.9990).

MID_LEVEL_RECONSTRUCTION._headline: STOP using released RoG endpoint strings as canonical entity identity. Reconstruct the benchmark graph from the underlying Freebase IDs, preserve real KG identity and topology, and attach human-readable Freebase metadata SEPARATELY.
MID_LEVEL_RECONSTRUCTION._the_correction: MIDs are NOT the problem. MIDs are exactly what we should preserve as identity -- Google documents them as stable identifiers deliberately not meant to convey meaning to humans, and real KGs do use IDs internally. FEEDING THE MID ITSELF AS SEMANTIC TEXT is the problem. What papers avoid is passing a meaningless id to a language model as the text representation, not using ids as identity.

target_representation.HUMAN_TEXT: Barack Obama; aliases: Barack Hussein Obama II; types: people.person, government.politician

MID_LEVEL_RECONSTRUCTION.why_better_than_released_endpoints: Released mixed endpoints give surface collision, identity loss, and irrecoverable MID identity. The audit's 1,782 names mapping to multiple MIDs proves surface strings are not safe identity keys. Reconstructing at MID level yields no collision, no fabricated identity, no arbitrary neighbour labels, and preserves the original graph structure.
MID_LEVEL_RECONSTRUCTION.reconstruction_path: RoG official repo -> its 'Subgraph Extraction' section -> NSM Freebase preprocessing (RichardHGL/WSDM2021_NSM/preprocessing/Freebase). NSM's recipe: FastRDFStore-data.zip -> fb_en.txt + cvtnodes.bin -> filter Freebase relations -> collect question topic entities -> extract 2-hop neighbourhoods -> preserve CVT traversal. NSM's code checks actual m.*/g.* ids and explicitly loads CVT nodes; it does not require names as graph identities.

MID_LEVEL_RECONSTRUCTION.established_resources: This problem is solved in the ecosystem -- GrailQA combines FACC1 mentions with Freebase names/aliases and Wikipedia keys; ChatKBQA and KBQA-o1 use the standard Freebase Virtuoso setup; idirlab/freebases exposes object_names, object_types, entities_id_label, properties_id_label. CVT_policy.identity: preserve the CVT MID in graph identity
CVT_policy.text: deterministic SCHEMA representation only if semantic retrieval text is required, e.g. 'CVT types: people.marriage; relations: people.marriage.spouse, .from, .to'
CVT_policy.alternative_to_test: CVTs may instead be structure-only nodes with NO Dense/SPLADE text. Test which suits L1.

SHARED_REPRESENTATION_LAYER._rule: DO NOT maintain two different preprocessing philosophies. Do not build RoG one way and Freebase-24M another way.
SHARED_REPRESENTATION_LAYER._datasets_are_scopes: The two datasets are simply different GRAPH SCOPES over one canonical layer: full ~24.9M graph -> RoG scope (~2.57M nodes) OR full scale (~24.9M nodes).
SHARED_REPRESENTATION_LAYER.consistency_check: Every RoG entity/triple should map back into the larger Freebase representation wherever the benchmark pipeline permits. This is a valuable cross-validation, not a formality.
SHARED_REPRESENTATION_LAYER.identity_rule: MID is ALWAYS the identity. The name is ONLY the semantic representation for Dense/SPLADE. We never replace the MID with 'Barack Obama' as identity.
SHARED_REPRESENTATION_LAYER.cvt_rule: CVT/mediator nodes preserved as graph nodes, represented STRUCTURALLY, never given fake neighbour names.

SCALE_24M_ENGINEERING._rule: Feasible but NOT as one enormous monolithic build. Everything shards.
SCALE_24M_ENGINEERING.the_principle_being_demonstrated: query-independent expensive work happens ONCE offline; query-time work is tiny relative to the full graph. That is exactly what L1 is supposed to demonstrate.
SCALE_24M_ENGINEERING.KNN_OPEN_QUESTION: Do NOT start by building semantic KNN across all 24.9M until it is profiled. Current H4 uses SK = STRUCT + KNN. The canonical-scale run must establish whether full-graph KNN is computationally practical AND still worth its cost. STRUCT itself is naturally available from Freebase, so a STRUCT-only H4 is the fallback that needs no KNN at all.
SCALE_24M_ENGINEERING._precedent: Track A Phase 12 already found SKN never regresses but never wins the shipped cell either, and costs more offline everywhere. At 24.9M that cost argument gets much sharper.

final_program.webqsp_rog_standard: ~2.57M -- standard benchmark; exact N from the MID-level reconstruction, not assumed

CVT_POLICY_ANSWERED_2026_09_05.RECOMMENDATION: CVTs are STRUCTURE-ONLY nodes: give them a graph identity and NO Dense/SPLADE text. If retrieval text is ever required, use the deterministic schema string 'CVT | types: <sorted types> | relations: <sorted relations>' -- never a neighbour name.
evidence: Prior KGQA code treats CVTs as structure, never as text. NSM's util/deal_cvt.py::is_cvt is a pure boolean membership test used only to steer traversal: get_2hop_subgraph.py uses it to decide whether to take an extra hop, preprocess_step1.py uses it to drop a dangling CVT triple as meaningless. NSM never reads or assigns a CVT label.

They carry almost no distinguishing text: under the deterministic recipe the 967,122 pass-1 CVTs collapse to only 2,155 DISTINCT strings (449x compression). The single most common string covers 129,982 nodes ('CVT | types: film.performance | relations: film.performance.film'); the top eight cover ~343k. A vector shared by 130,000 nodes cannot discriminate between them.
The alternative is the documented catastrophe at src/pipeline/loader_webqsp.py:52-60,68 -- verified directly in Phase 7, not cited from the prior audit.
CVT_POLICY_ANSWERED_2026_09_05.encoder_cost_consequence: If CVTs are structure-only, 1,588,085 nodes need no vector at all and DENSE_REENCODE_N falls from 2,070,021 to 481,936 -- a 77% cut. If CVT text is kept, cost is bounded by DISTINCT texts (2,155), not node count. Either way the real work is the ~1.0M ordinary topics.
CVT_POLICY_ANSWERED_2026_09_05.both_variants_retained: the schema recipe is kept as a documented option so structure-only vs schema-text can be A/B'd at L1 without any corpus change. Under either variant the CVT keeps its own MID as identity and never borrows a name.
